explanation: The new name honoured the medieval Ghana Empire, though that empire lay hundreds of kilometres to the north-west, in modern Mali and Mauritania.

claims.text: Kwame Nkrumah led the Gold Coast to independence as Ghana in March 1957.
Jomo Kenyatta led Kenya, independent in 1963, Julius Nyerere led Tanganyika, independent in 1961, and Patrice Lumumba led Congo, independent in 1960.
Ghana was named after the medieval Ghana Empire.
The medieval Ghana Empire lay hundreds of kilometres north-west of modern Ghana, in parts of modern Mali and Mauritania.
